To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Place attachment is related to information processing, (2) The relation between place attachment and in- formation processing is different for each aspect of place attachment, (3) The relation between information processing and place attachment is not the same for all types of information processing, and (4) Information processing tendencies are not the same for each aspect of information processing.
the information processing tendencies of the four aspects of place attach- ment are significantly related to each other.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between information processing tendencies and place attachment.
the relation between place attachment and the way people perceive and process information about their environment, and how this information is used to create meaning.
how people perceive and process information about places.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
place attachment is related to information processing tendencies, and that the more the information processing tendency is developed, the more the place attachment will be developed.
place attachment can be seen as a function of information processing tendencies.
place attachment is not a single, uni- dimensional concept but rather a multidimensional construct.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to show that the meaning theory of information processing can help to better understand the relationship between people and their environment.
the meaning of place is not only a function of the place itself, but also of the individual who experiences it.
the Meaning Test is a useful tool for assessing the information processing tendencies of different aspects of place attachment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the way we interact with our environments is related to the meaning of the spaces we are interacting with, and to our personality tendencies.
place attachment is not a uni- dimensional construct but rather is composed of different aspects.
place attachment is a complex construct, which is related to the individual’s information processing tendencies.
